text: すこし　ここに　くるのが　おそいようだが……

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. ここに　くるのが = 'coming here'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a statement says that this is how things look to the speaker. おそいようだ = 'it seems to be slow'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement means 'but' or 'though', and leaving the rest unsaid makes the remark gentler. おそいようだが…… = 'it seems slow, though...'.
